notes: Under spec/bugs/, the bug docs state every alias rule: a set at the anchor changes every alias, a set through an alias is refused with exit 3 and a pointer to --expand-alias, --expand-alias makes a block-style copy, and merge keys are never written. They cite issue troupe-run/repo#2 and name the regression tests in tests/e2e/test_set_alias.py, including the reported scenario. But the main spec at spec.md:288-289 still lists anchors, aliases and merge keys as 'Out of contract (until step 6)', so an implementer who reads only the main spec would never see these rules.
